notes.title: Back on Track – Little Astronaut Development Update 🚀
notes.content:
Hello Space Travelers!

I’m excited to share that I’m back working full-time on Little Astronaut. The Steam page is being updated regularly with new info and fresh screenshots, so be sure to check in from time to time.

The playable demo is planned for release this October. Until then, every bit of support matters: please add the game to your wishlist if you haven’t already, and share it with your friends. Every single wishlist truly helps the project’s future.

Thank you all for your patience and encouragement—more news coming soon!
